records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Silver Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Your workspace for Silver Ventures is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outbound emails (email:c029c0e2, email:a44a8c1c) or tickets — no sign of engagement. Internal note (slack:a9d02da8) shows no contact made. Starter solo admins with no week-one activity rarely self-start in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Silver Ventures' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my note last week — I know new tools tend to slide down the list during a busy stretch, so no worries if Wrenfield has been sitting idle.

One thing worth knowing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to sit with you while you set up that first project and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Priya
